Provide guaranteed minimum underside and maximum top height after specified soldering/seating, plus allowable solder thickness/fillet and foot flatness. Supply STEP or controlled profile including bend radii.

For100 boards, specify overage, setup/placement/loose-part/consignment/customs fees, applicable conflicting overseas fee schedule, and residual inventory terms. No order or communication sent.
qualification_boundary: Nominal manufacturer geometry supports private construction/rejection screening only. Neither20A catalog wording nor an assembler's ability to place the part establishes two solder joints, PCB land access, new layer transitions, enclosed-stack thermal behavior, or unchanged complete assembled Z. These need vendor limits and source-bound physical/current receiving, followed by appropriate sample/application validation.
